question: At what times of day should the bathing of Shiva be performed?
premises: The bathing may be done at both twilights
It may be done at one twilight
The bathing is to be caused for Shiva
inference: One should have the bathing of Shiva performed at one or both twilights
plain_english: One should have the bathing of Shiva performed at both twilights or at one of them.
